I am getting old and my bones are not what they used to be, but I have my sons and their families to help me work this big piece of land. Here in Shinyanga the rains come when they come, and the soil gives what it gives — I have never used those expensive chemical fertilizers or the new seeds from the shops, and I do not plan to start now at my age. We will clear the land with our hoes, plant our traditional crops as we always have, and hire some young men from the village to help with the heavy work of clearing and weeding. God willing the rains will be enough, as they have been most years.
